author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: clue ব্যবহার করে শূন্যস্থান পূরণ করো (কঠিন)।

items.q: Hardly had he entered the room ___ the light went off. (when/than)

items.rule_bn: 'would sooner ... than' — একটির বদলে অন্যটি পছন্দ।

items.q: It is over a year ___ we last met. (since)
So sooner had the bell rung ___ the students left. (than)
I would rather you ___ (go) now. (past form)
items.rule_bn: 'would rather + subject'-এর পরে past form: went।

items.q: Provided that he ___ (come), we will start. (present)
He talks big as if he ___ (be) a millionaire. (past)
